label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

ExportButton.tsx uses local state initialized with defaultFormat without persisting or retrieving the user's previously selected export format. Updating the component to read and write the last used export format from and to localStorage will ensure user preferences persist correctly across sessions.
